observations: A green-faced figure with pink circular eyes marked with X crosses and an open mouth sits at center, outlined in thick black, with a yellow-orange body that spreads into looping, coiling forms below.
Two large pointed shapes in yellow with black outlines flank the head at upper left and upper right, filled with patches of red, blue, and green that bleed into the white background.
Magenta scribble marks form a loose rectangular border around the composition, while shorter black and blue scratch lines fill the corners, leaving the white ground visible between strokes.
reading: The X-marked eyes and open mouth read as alarm or shock, yet the yellow-orange looping body below feels almost celebratory. Magenta border scribbles push inward while the flanking pointed shapes pull outward, creating a tug between containment and expansion. A small starred burst near the bottom center echoes the eye marks, repeating the X motif at a different scale.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, nnxyz nnotb #1 fork shares thick black outlines and a magenta scribble field but replaces the white ground with a flat sky-blue fill. Both works use yellow as a structural color, though here it defines the body rather than accent dashes.

connections.reason: Both works use thick black outlines enclosing yellow-filled forms against a field of magenta scribble marks, but the fork's solid blue background makes the figure read as more grounded where #2 feels suspended in white space.

lookingQuestion: Where does the yellow-orange line that forms the body actually begin and end, and how many times does it cross itself before reaching the bottom of the image?
ambiguities: The flanking shapes could be read as wings, horns, or abstract geometric forms; no supplied evidence resolves which reading the work supports.
nnxyz nnotb #3 and rawblocks #34 were inspected but offer no stronger formal connection than the fork; rawblocks #34 uses a maze-pattern ground entirely unlike the white field here.
